recipe.title: Creamy chicken, rice and vege soup
recipe.notes: This is from a Nadia Lim cookbook.

i.n: butternut or pumpkin, peeled and grated
sour cream, and extra to serve

method.s: Heat olive oil in a large pot on medium heat. Add onion, butternut, celery and leek. Cover and fry for about 4 minutes, stirring occasionally until vegetables are starting to become tender.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and season with salt.
Add thyme, rice, chicken thighs, chicken stock and water to the pot. Bring to the boil, stirring.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer gently for 15-20 minutes until chicken is just cooked through and rice is soft.
Reduce heat to very low, remove chicken, finely dice or shred and return to pot. Stir through sour cream and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Serve with an extra dollop of sour cream and sprinkle with fresh parsley.
